title: Claude Code SessionStart hook output
description: JSON a SessionStart hook prints on stdout (exit 0). Injects context at the start of a session; it cannot block.

hookEventName.description: Discriminator; must match the firing event.

additionalContext.description: Context added at the start of the conversation, before the first prompt. Multiple hooks' values are concatenated.

initialUserMessage.description: Optional. Becomes the first user message of the session (applies in non-interactive -p mode); creates a turn, unlike additionalContext.

watchPaths.description: Optional. Absolute paths to watch for FileChanged events for the rest of this session.

continue.description: If false, Claude stops processing entirely after the hook runs.

stopReason.description: Message shown to the user when 'continue' is false. Not shown to Claude.

suppressOutput.description: If true, hides the hook's stdout from the transcript.

systemMessage.description: Warning message shown to the user.

terminalSequence.description: Terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook (OSC 0/1/2/9/99/777 and BEL only; anything else is ignored). Requires Claude Code v2.1.141+.
